subject: a 14th-century Moroccan Muslim scholar and traveller with a neatly trimmed dark beard, a white turban, a long cream tunic under a hooded wool burnous, a leather satchel and a wooden walking staff, alert curious eyes

panels.01-departure: a young {S}, about twenty-one, walking alone out of the whitewashed gate of the walled port town of Tangier at sunrise in 1325, the Strait of Gibraltar glittering behind him, looking back once toward home, determined, wide cinematic shot, North Africa, 14th century
panels.02-caravan: a long pilgrim caravan of camels and travellers in simple white garments crossing a vast moonlit desert of the Hejaz in 1326, {S} riding among them, lanterns and campfires, distant hills, a respectful and peaceful mood, no holy buildings shown, 14th century
panels.03-dhow: {S} standing at the rail of a lateen-sailed wooden dhow arriving at a coral-stone Swahili trading town on the East African coast around 1330, palm trees, merchants unloading bales of cloth on the beach, bright tropical light, Indian Ocean, 14th century
panels.04-delhi: {S} in finer robes standing respectfully in a vast columned audience hall of the sultan of Delhi in 1334, courtiers and scribes in Indo-Islamic dress, carved red sandstone arches, being appointed a judge, dignified and formal, 14th century India
panels.05-storm: {S} standing on a sandy shore beside a small mosque at night in 1342, watching a violent storm toss large wooden trading ships in the harbour of Calicut, wind-bent coconut palms, lightning over the dark sea, worried figures with lanterns, no bodies, Malabar coast India, 14th century
panels.06-junk: {S} on the deck of a huge multi-masted Chinese junk with ribbed matting sails entering the busy harbour of Quanzhou in 1345, many ships, pagodas and warehouses on the shore, Chinese merchants in Yuan dynasty robes, morning haze, 14th century
panels.07-sahara: an older {S} with grey in his beard leading a camel caravan through the Sahara in 1352, arriving at a small desert village whose houses are built of blocks of rock salt roofed with camel hides, endless dunes, harsh sun, merchants and camels, 14th century West Africa
panels.08-dictation: an older {S} with a greying beard seated on cushions in a tiled courtyard room in Fez in 1355, telling his stories while a younger court secretary in a turban writes them down with a reed pen on paper, oil lamp, carved plaster and zellige tiles, calm and scholarly, 14th century Morocco
